notes: Stories created for EVAL-CT-M3 with full lifecycle coverage (schema, logic, API, tests, integration).

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for relevance scoring
Added core logic for condition and eligibility matching
Added unit and edge case tests for relevance scoring

EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Trial Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define a structured schema for trial relevance including condition match strength, eligibility alignment, and overall relevance score. Extend existing clinical trial models to include normalized fields for condition tokens, inclusion/exclusion criteria signals, and computed relevance metadata.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Build core logic to match user query intent against trial condition fields and eligibility criteria. Include token normalization, synonym handling, and partial match scoring. Compute a composite relevance score combining condition match and eligibility alignment.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Expose Relevance Signals via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Integrate relevance scoring into the evaluate_care_facade response so that each clinical trial result includes relevance score and supporting signals (matched condition terms, eligibility flags). Ensure compatibility with existing tool routing and response formatting.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Unit Tests for Relevance Scoring and Edge Cases
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Create unit tests covering exact matches, partial matches, synonym handling, and mismatched eligibility scenarios. Validate score consistency and ensure deterministic outputs for identical inputs.
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials relevance tests found; must create new test module under backend/tests/

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Integrate Relevance Scoring into Clinical Trials Pipeline
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Embed relevance scoring into the clinical_trials_service workflow so that trials returned from ClinicalTrials.gov API are scored and optionally ranked before being passed to the facade. Ensure no regression in existing filtering (e.g., recruiting status).
